instruction:
OUTPUT FORMAT INSTRUCTIONS:
Generate exactly {num_samples} samples.
Separate each sample with a line containing only '---'.
Do NOT include any preamble, explanation, or commentary.
Output ONLY the samples separated by '---'.

metadata.notes: Appended to a generation prompt's system_prompt (PromptTemplate's format_style="delimiter") so its paired extractor (extract_and_clean(style="delimiter") / extract_delimited()) can parse the reply.
